label: typhoid
description: Matches texts describing a combination of at least one core GI symptom (vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, constipation) and at least one systemic symptom or abdominal pain (fever, headache, abdominal/stomach pain).

label: chicken pox
description: Identifies explicit mentions of 'red spots', 'patches', or 'rashes' combined with any general systemic symptom or itching, as these are strong indicators not present in counter-examples. Priority increased to resolve conflict with typhoid.

label: psoriasis
description: Identifies characteristic nail problems like small dents, pits, or strange inflammation, which are strong indicators of psoriatic nail disease.

label: psoriasis
description: Captures various descriptions of joint pain, often with strong adjectives (e.g., excruciating, extreme), which is a key symptom of psoriatic arthritis.

label: varicose veins
description: Matches mentions of cramps specifically located in the legs or calves, including pain similar to cramps.
